rawContent: If you haven’t watched “Our National Parks” on Netflix, you are missing out. The photography is beautiful, and hearing President Obama narrate it is good for my soul. It is optimistic and I appreciate hearing some good after all the stress over #ClimateCrisis

So, in response to a question about #ClimateCrisis this morning, @SenatorLankford said “we’ll adapt.” Disappointing take. No species can adapt as quickly as the climate is changing. None of us. He scoffed at the thought of 158,000,000 impoverished people drowning: they can move.
